title: Symmetric and skew-symmetric matrices
section: Chapter 5 Review Questions ▷ Symmetric Matrix Spaces
terms: symmetric matrix; skew-symmetric matrix; symmetric matrix space; dimension of sym- metric matrices.

exposition.text:

A real square matrix is symmetric if A = A and skew-symmetric if A = −A. A symmetric
n × n matrix is determined by its n diagonal entries and n(n − 1)/2 entries above the diagonal,
so the symmetric space has dimension n(n + 1)/2.
A real skew-symmetric matrix has zero diagonal and dimension n(n − 1)/2. Every real square

niteness instead is not a subspace condition.

question.text:
What is the dimension of the real symmetric 4 × 4 matrices with trace zero?
(A) 5 (B) 6 (C) 8 (D) 9 (E) 10

solution.text:
The symmetric space has dimension 4 · 5/2 = 10. The trace condition is one nonzero linear
constraint, reducing the dimension to 9.

question.text:
For a nonzero real column vector x and a real skew-symmetric matrix A, which inequality al-
ways holds?
T 2 T 2 2
(A) x A x > 0 (B) x A x = ∥Ax∥
T 2 2 T 2 2
(C) x A x = −∥Ax∥ ≤ 0 (D) x A x ≥ ∥x∥
T 2 2
(E) x A x = −∥x∥

solution.text:
T 2 T T T 2
Since A = −A, ∥Ax∥ = x A Ax = −x A x. Thus the square of a real skew-symmetric
matrix is negative semidefinite. In particular it cannot equal I in positive dimension.

question.text:
If real symmetric matrices A, B have symmetric product AB, what must hold?
(A) A is invertible (B) AB = 0 (C) AB = BA (D) A = B (E) B is diagonal

solution.text:
T T T
Because A = A and B = B, (AB) = BA. Symmetry of the product is exactly the equal-
ity AB = BA.

question.text:
Let P be the positive definite real symmetric n × n matrices, with n ≥ 1. Which claim is true?
(A) P is a vector subspace.
(B) If A, B ∈ P, then A − B ∈ P.
(C) If A, B ∈ P and 0 < t < 1, then tA + (1 − t)B ∈ P.
(D) If A ∈ P, then −A ∈ P.
(E) The zero matrix belongs to P.

solution.text:
T T
For nonzero x, the quadratic form of the convex combination is tx Ax + (1 − t)x Bx > 0.
Symmetry is also preserved. Subtraction can yield zero, and negative scaling reverses the
sign, so this class is not a vector subspace.
